en.title: Number of Contiguous Fragments That Match After At Most One Adjacent Swap
en.description:
Count the contiguous fragments of content whose length equals that of target and that become equal to target either with no swap or after swapping one pair of adjacent characters inside the fragment. Fragments with different start positions are counted separately.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, editorial and tests; missing original bounds and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the statement.
en.input: Two lines of input: target, then content. Original bounds: both consist of lowercase letters, 1≤|target|≤|content|≤50.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: In the first example the valid windows are mono at start 0 and omon at start 3, fixed by swapping the last two and the first two characters respectively; the answer is 2. The onom in the source explanation is not the corresponding window.
hints: For each window, find the positions that differ. If there are none, it is valid; otherwise there must be exactly two differing positions, adjacent to each other, whose characters match crosswise after the swap.
